levelcfo-open-finance-skills-ar-integrit.description: Audit the invoice, payment, deposit, and balance chain and find AR records whose statuses do not match the money.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-cash-flow-f.description: Build a rolling 13-week cash forecast with explicit assumptions, scenarios, and presentation-ready charts.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-categorizat.description: Test whether transaction categorization history is consistent and sufficient to support automation rules.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-cfo-chart-p.description: Generate clear cash-flow, margin, working-capital, and variance charts from verified finance tables.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-cost-detail.description: Test whether a supporting cost schedule foots to its control total and preserve the exact variance.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-cost-ration.description: Find non-headcount SG&A savings candidates without recommending cuts that would damage delivery or controls.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-customer-ma.description: Determine whether revenue and direct costs can support customer-level margin analysis and identify attribution gaps.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-duplicate-b.description: Detect exact and probable duplicate invoices or payments and prepare an evidence-backed review queue.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-idle-cash-i.description: Estimate potential interest opportunity on apparently idle cash while preserving liquidity, bank-risk, and tax constraints.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-root.description: Route cash flow, margin, billing, spend, reconciliation, close, and CFO-review questions to twenty evidence-first finance skills from Level.
levelcfo-open-finance-skills-root.author: Level

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-margin-tren.description: Recompute margin trends, flag material changes, and organize possible operating drivers for human investigation.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-month-end-c.description: Preview month-end close readiness across reconciliations, schedules, exceptions, and sign-offs without closing the books.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-monthly-val.description: Turn completed finance reviews into a concise monthly summary of findings, decisions, owners, and measured value.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-monthly-var.description: Compare monthly actuals with budget and prior periods, prioritize material variances, and prepare driver questions.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-reconcile-a.description: Reconcile a bank or balance-sheet account to its ledger and surface unexplained differences without inventing missing evidence.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-recurring-s.description: Detect recurring software and service charges, price changes, overlaps, and possible unused subscriptions.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-remittance-.description: Match remittance advice to payments and invoices while preserving ambiguous and partial allocations for review.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-revenue-lea.description: Find completed work that may be unbilled or underbilled while preserving contract and warranty exceptions.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-spend-conce.description: Measure vendor and category concentration and distinguish recurring dependence from one-time purchasing cycles.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-vendor-1099.description: Check vendor records and payment totals for 1099 and W-9 preparation gaps without making tax determinations.

levelcfo-open-finance-skills-vendor-rule.description: Audit vendor categorization rules against transaction history and surface rules that are stale, conflicting, or too broad.
